title: Apply the standard BDD + Allure architecture to a Playwright app
description: Configures an existing Nx Playwright application with playwright-bdd, Allure reporting and the shared @willstjohnbacon/nx-bdd runtime.

project.description: The Nx Playwright application to configure.
project.x-prompt: Which project should the BDD architecture be applied to?

featuresGlob.description: Glob for Cucumber feature files, relative to the project root.

stepsGlob.description: Glob for step definition files, relative to the project root.

baseUrl.description: Default URL the browser navigates to, used when BASE_URL is unset. Point this at whatever serves the app under test.

apiBaseUrl.description: Default base URL of the HTTP API backing the suite, used when API_BASE_URL is unset.

skipPackageJson.description: Skip adding the BDD and Allure dependencies to package.json.
